map.尿道狭窄可能性评分：Qmax 小于10 加3（小于15 加1）+ Qmax/Qa: Urethral stricture likelihood score: Qmax <10 adds 3 (<15 adds 1) plus Qmax/Qave <1.5 adds 3 (<2 adds 1) plus a plateau curve adds 3 (interrupted adds 2) plus voiding >30 s with a volume >=150 mL adds 1; >=6 highly suspicious, >=3 suspicious.

map.尿道狭窄/梗阻典型: Typical of urethral stricture or obstruction
map.多次中断，靠腹压排尿: Multiple interruptions, voiding by abdominal pressure
map.Qmax/Qave 比值正常 >2，狭窄时比值降低（曲线变平）。\n:
The normal Qmax/Qave ratio is >2 and the ratio falls when a stricture is present (the curve flattens).
A plateau curve plus Qmax <10 mL/s strongly suggests urethral stricture; confirmation requires urethrography or urethroscopy.
